correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, every fixed point of the second iterate corresponds bijectively to an n-step closed walk of the complete 4096-vertex two-time column graph. The independently inspectable standard-library certificate checks all 262144 candidate local triples, finds exactly 6140 legal edges and cyclic components (30,75), (27,81), (4,4), with only the last non-phase-diagonal. Its internal edges form one directed four-cycle, proving exactly four nonfixed two-return configurations for multiples of four and none otherwise; direct full-state C++ checks for n=3..7 confirm. No inference from bounded experiments to infinity is made.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural invariant for the minimally nondegenerate three-row Moore torus: despite exponentially many fixed configurations, every genuine period-two state is a globally full-column four-stripe word, with an exact zero/two-orbit divisibility law independent of circumference. This rigid global exclusion is stronger than constructing examples and answers a question that McIntosh’s narrow-strip still-life de Bruijn analysis explicitly left computationally difficult.
